text.p: These are the leading stories in the Beirut press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
-Prime Minister Hariri's cabinet has last meeting today before resigning as mandate of parliament and the government ends at midnight.
-Lebanon's population totals 3.1 million, 13.6 percent of whom are illiterate, conference on population and housing says.
-Budget deficit over 50 percent and public debt $9.5 billion.
-Ceasefire monitoring committee aproves Lebanon's request for sending two fact-finding missions to south Lebanon to investigate Israeli shelling of civilians on Saturday.
-Parliament speaker Berri says corruption investigations will continue to the end.
-Israelis shell south Lebanon and resistence attacks an SLA patrol.
-Private audovisual media employees to stage strike and demonstrations on October 22.
